resources.string: Take a break from internet access in apps you choose. Apps can still open and use offline content.
The VPN feature is experimental and has not been verified on your device. Selected apps are saved on this device.
Some installed apps may not appear because of Android’s app visibility rules.
No launchable apps are available to select.
Choose at least one app to continue.
Protection depends on Android routing and device behavior. A VPN connection does not guarantee every network path is blocked.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 720.
Runs until stopped or interrupted when protection is available.
Apps can still open and use offline content.
Starting will request Android VPN consent if needed.

Social Pause uses Android’s VPN to route selected apps’ traffic into a local drop tunnel. It does not connect to a remote VPN server. This implementation is experimental and has not been verified on this device.
Saved selections are stored on this device and excluded from Android backup. This feature does not send app lists or packet data to a server.

Another VPN may conflict. Android routing, profiles and device policies can affect protection. Apps can still open and use offline content. Calls and SMS are not blocked. Protection may stop and will not restart automatically.
This removes your saved app choices from this device.
Couldn’t save your selection. Try again.
Some previously selected apps are no longer visible. Remove them before continuing.
Selected apps may reconnect to the internet.

Android will ask to set up a VPN. Traffic routed from selected apps is discarded locally. Another VPN may be replaced or prevent this one from starting. Apps can still open and use offline content. Protection can stop unexpectedly and is not guaranteed.
Applying changes rebuilds the VPN. Selected apps may briefly reconnect. If setup fails, protection stops.
VPN consent was denied. Protection did not start.
Couldn’t start the VPN service. Protection is not active.
Protection stopped or could not start. Selected apps may be online. Review the selection and try again.
An established tunnel does not guarantee all traffic is blocked. Verify behavior on your device.
If notification permission is denied, the session notification may not appear in the notification drawer. Check Android settings.
A selected app is no longer available. Review your app choices.
VPN permission is unavailable or was revoked. Review and request permission again.
Android did not allow the foreground service to start. Check device settings and try again.
Session information could not be saved. Check device storage and try again.
The tunnel could not be established or an app was unavailable. Review your selection and VPN settings.
The cause may be unknown. Check VPN and device settings before retrying.
